changeSet.sql:
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'integration' AND TABLE_NAME = 'SynchedAssetType') BEGIN IF EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_IntegrationExecutionAssetType_IntegrationSynchedAssetType' and object_name(parent_object_id) = 'ExecutionAssetType' and schema_name(schema_id) = 'integration' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [integration].[ExecutionAssetType] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_IntegrationExecutionAssetType_IntegrationSynchedAssetType] END
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_IntegrationSynchedAssetTypeFieldItem_IntegrationSynchedAssetType' and object_name(parent_object_id) = 'SynchedAssetTypeFieldItem' and schema_name(schema_id) = 'integration' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [integration].[SynchedAssetTypeFieldItem] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_IntegrationSynchedAssetTypeFieldItem_IntegrationSynchedAssetType] END
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_IntegrationSynchedAssetTypeRelationItem_IntegrationSynchedAssetType' and object_name(parent_object_id) = 'SynchedAssetTypeRelationItem' and schema_name(schema_id) = 'integration' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [integration].[SynchedAssetTypeRelationItem] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_IntegrationSynchedAssetTypeRelationItem_IntegrationSynchedAssetType] END
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_IntegrationSynchedAssetTypeRoleItem_IntegrationSynchedAssetType' and object_name(parent_object_id) = 'SynchedAssetTypeRoleItem' and schema_name(schema_id) = 'integration' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [integration].[SynchedAssetTypeRoleItem] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_IntegrationSynchedAssetTypeRoleItem_IntegrationSynchedAssetType] END
exec sp_rename 'integration.SynchedAssetType', 'SynchedAssetType_backup'; END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'integration' AND TABLE_NAME = 'SynchedAssetType_backup') BEGIN exec sp_rename 'integration.SynchedAssetType_backup', 'SynchedAssetType'; END
